_meta.note: Real risk IDs, titles, ACAPS ratings and outcome text from the Risk Radar export. similarity scores are placeholders until similar_risk.json arrives from the ML pipeline.

items.title: Camps and basic services in East Darfur state are stretched beyond capacity following the influx of up to 100,000 South Sudanese refugees by June 2016
items.outcomeSummary: The refugee population in East Darfur state had dramatically increased by 2016, with numbers rising from 164 individuals in December 2015 to over 47,000 by June.

items.title: Intensifying humanitarian and security crisis in Kenya worsens conditions in refugee camps
items.outcomeSummary: Kenya’s humanitarian and security situation deteriorates, particularly in refugee-hosting areas such as Garissa and Turkana counties.

items.title: A prolonged Syria–Lebanon border conflict results in displacement and increases shelter and livelihood needs
items.outcomeSummary: The risk improved slightly in April 2026 after tensions rose in March with an escalation between Hezbollah and Israel.
